evals.prompt: make me a playlist
evals.expected_output: Asks the three core questions plus 'Fine-tune more?' in one round, then asks for anchor artists only if start from is artists or a mix. Makes no generate_playlist call yet.
expectations: Asks about start from, occasion and mood, and length, plus whether to fine-tune, in a single message
Does not call generate_playlist before the user has answered
Does not ask the user to pick genres

evals.prompt: Build me a 2 hour sad acoustic study playlist, mostly stuff I know. Anchors: Radiohead and The Goo Goo Dolls.
evals.expected_output: Skips questions the request already answers and goes straight to the judge round: parallel plain-name searches for both anchors, numbered tracks with links and saved markers, and similar-artist rows.
expectations: Does not re-ask length, mood, occasion or how new the music should be
Searches 'Radiohead' and 'The Goo Goo Dolls' as plain artist names, not vibe queries like 'chill songs like Radiohead'
Shows 6 to 9 numbered tracks with Spotify links
Marks tracks whose library_status is SAVED with a heart
Shows similar artists for each anchor

evals.prompt: [Simulated state] Interview: winding down, calm and sad, 2 hours, mostly familiar. Kept tracks: Radiohead - Fake Plastic Trees, Radiohead - Exit Music (For A Film), The Goo Goo Dolls - Iris. Seed playlists picked: Late nights, Rainy days. Now generate it.
evals.expected_output: One generate_playlist call whose description follows the template, uses 120 minutes, names both seed playlists and the kept tracks, and adds no constraints the user did not give.
expectations: Makes exactly one generate_playlist call
Description says about 120 minutes, not 2 hours
Description names the playlists Late nights and Rainy days
Description names Fake Plastic Trees, Exit Music and Iris with their artists
Description ends with 'Mostly songs and artists I already listen to, plus some lesser-known songs.'
Description adds no decade, language, explicitness or genre constraint

evals.prompt: [Simulated state] A playlist was just generated. User: 'nice, but can it be more upbeat?'
evals.expected_output: Changes only the mood part of the previous description and calls generate_playlist again.
expectations: Keeps the length, seeds, vibe list and adventure line from the previous description
Changes the mood wording to something more upbeat
Calls generate_playlist once more

evals.prompt: [Simulated state] No Spotify tools are available in this session. User: 'make me a road trip playlist'
evals.expected_output: Explains that the Spotify connector is needed and how to connect it, then stops instead of inventing a playlist.
expectations: Tells the user to connect the Spotify connector
Does not invent a track list or a fake playlist link

evals.prompt: [Simulated state] ~/.claude/spotify-taste.md lists anchors Them & I and Dead Calm and seed playlist new yearns. User: 'playlist for tonight please'
evals.expected_output: Reads the profile and offers its anchors and seed playlist as defaults for the user to confirm, instead of asking from scratch or using them silently.
expectations: Offers Them & I and Dead Calm as default anchors
Offers new yearns as a seed playlist
Asks the user to confirm before using them

evals.prompt: find me a few songs like what I've been listening to this week
evals.expected_output: Runs songs mode: searches 'my recently played tracks this week', runs a judge round, lists kept tracks with links, offers to save them, and does not call generate_playlist.
expectations: Searches 'my recently played tracks this week' with limit 20
Shows numbered tracks with Spotify links for the user to judge
Does not call generate_playlist unless the user asks for a playlist
Calls save_to_library only for tracks the user names

evals.prompt: [Simulated state] Settings: mellow, 60 minutes, adventure 4 (mostly new), start from this week, no seeds. Kept tracks: Slowdive - When the Sun Hits, Bon Iver - Skinny Love. Now generate it.
evals.expected_output: One generate_playlist call using the 'this week' source and the level 4 adventure line, with no seed playlists clause.
expectations: Description contains 'based on the songs I've been listening to this week'
Description ends with 'Mostly new artists I haven't heard yet, and lesser-known songs over the obvious hits.'
Description names When the Sun Hits and Skinny Love with their artists
Description has no 'my playlists' clause
Passes a language parameter

evals.prompt: [Simulated state] ~/.claude/spotify-taste.md defaults: Mode playlist, Occasion studying, Mood calm, Length 90 minutes, Adventure 2, Start from most played, Seeds none. User: 'playlist please'
evals.expected_output: Uses the fast path: shows the settings in one line and asks to confirm or change, instead of running the interview.
expectations: Shows the profile defaults in a single confirmation message
Does not run the interview
After confirmation, searches 'my most played songs' for the judge round

evals.prompt: Make me a 30 minute playlist, all new artists only, based on my most played songs.
evals.expected_output: Maps 'all new artists only' to adventure level 5 and does not re-ask how new, length or start from.
expectations: Does not re-ask how new the music should be, length or start from
The final description contains 'Only artists I haven't listened to before, mostly deep cuts.'
The final description says about 30 minutes

evals.prompt: make me a cozy evening playlist from Nude by Radiohead, about 90 minutes
evals.expected_output: Starts from one song: searches 'songs similar to Nude by Radiohead', 'Radiohead' and 'artists similar to Radiohead' in parallel, then shows a judge round that alternates artists.
expectations: Runs the similar-songs, plain-artist and similar-artists searches
Never lists two tracks by the same artist next to each other in the judge round
Leaves out artists whose playback status is NOT_PLAYABLE
Does not re-ask length, occasion or mood

evals.prompt: [Simulated state] Settings: cozy evening, 105 minutes, start from Nude by Radiohead, steady, adventure 2. Kept: Radiohead - Reckoner, Radiohead - All I Need, Radiohead - Let Down, The Smiths - There Is a Light That Never Goes Out, Slowdive - When the Sun Hits, Jeff Buckley - So Real. Seeds: Late nights, Rainy days. Now generate it.
evals.expected_output: Writes a description that opens with the seed playlists as the main source, names at most one track per artist, and includes the artist cap line.
expectations: Description contains 'built mainly from songs in my playlists Late nights and Rainy days'
Description names at most one Radiohead track besides the Nude start line
Description contains 'At most 3 songs per artist, and never two songs by the same artist in a row.'
Description contains 'Keep a steady vibe.' and 'Mostly songs and artists I already listen to, plus some lesser-known songs.'

evals.prompt: merge my playlists Late nights and Rainy days into one, about 90 minutes, drop the songs I'm sick of and keep my favourites
evals.expected_output: Runs merge mode: confirms both playlists exist via 'my playlists', says honestly that the generator picks the songs, and uses the merge template.
expectations: Searches 'my playlists' to find both playlists
Tells the user Claude cannot read the playlists, so the generator picks the songs
Description contains 'merges my playlists Late nights and Rainy days'
Description contains 'Leave out songs I've played a lot lately.' and 'Keep the songs I've liked.'

evals.prompt: [Simulated state] ~/.claude/spotify-taste.md has 'Depth: quick' (an older profile) and no other defaults. User: 'playlist please'
evals.expected_output: Treats Depth: quick as Fine-tune: never. Asks only the three core questions (start from, occasion and mood, length) in one round, with no fine-tune offer and no questions about adventure, arc, songs per artist or leave out.
expectations: Asks start from, occasion and mood, and length in one message
Does not offer to fine-tune
Does not ask about adventure, arc, songs per artist or leave out

evals.prompt: [Simulated state] generate_playlist just returned the playlist 'Cozy Evening Echoes'.
evals.expected_output: Wrap-up gives the link, says it won't show up in the Spotify library until saved, and asks whether to save it, without saving unasked.
expectations: Says the playlist won't show up in the library until it's saved
Asks before calling save_to_library
Does not promise an exact new-versus-known split or artist cap

evals.prompt: [Simulated state] Step 4a: 'my playlists' returned three playlists named '.', plus Photo album (own) and acoustic and chill (followed).
evals.expected_output: Lists own playlists first, labels the followed one, and warns that the three '.' playlists can't be told apart in a description.
expectations: Shows Photo album before acoustic and chill
Labels acoustic and chill as followed
Warns that playlists named '.' are ambiguous

evals.prompt: [Simulated state] Settings: rainy afternoon, 60 minutes, start from artists Phoebe Bridgers and Bon Iver, no seeds. Fine-tune answers: adventure 3, songs per artist 1, leave out 'Coldplay and anything too loud'. Kept: Phoebe Bridgers - Motion Sickness, Bon Iver - Holocene. Now generate it.
evals.expected_output: One generate_playlist call with the 1-per-artist line, the level 3 adventure line and the leave-out line in the user's words.
expectations: Description contains 'At most 1 song per artist.'
Description contains 'Half songs I already listen to, half new artists, with some deep cuts.'
Description contains 'Leave out Coldplay and anything too loud.'
Description does not contain 'At most 3 songs per artist'

evals.prompt: [Simulated state] No taste profile. Core answers: one song, winding down, 180 minutes, no fine-tune. Judge round shown. User: 'all of them, and I'm willing to give the unknown artists a try'
evals.expected_output: Keeps every shown track and similar artist, reads the hint as adventure 3 instead of the default 2, and says that change in one line before moving to seeds.
expectations: Keeps all shown tracks and similar artists
Sets adventure to 3 (half and half)
Tells the user in one line that the adventure setting changed
Moves on to the seed playlist question

evals.prompt: [Simulated state] Client renders elicitation forms (show_widget). No taste profile. User: 'make me a playlist'
evals.expected_output: Searches 'my playlists' first, then shows one interview form with start from, song or artists, mood, occasion, length, adventure, songs per artist, seeds, leave out, name and a skip-judge option. Makes no generate_playlist call yet.
expectations: Searches 'my playlists' before showing the form
Shows a single form instead of several question rounds
The form includes the user's playlists as seed options
Does not ask about arc
Does not call generate_playlist before the form is answered

evals.prompt: [Simulated state] Form answers: Start from: One song · Song or artists: Nude by Radiohead · Mood: Calm · Occasion: Falling asleep · Length minutes: 45 · Adventure: 2 · Songs per artist: 2 · Seeds: None · Judge round: Skip, just make it · Playlist name: Night drift
evals.expected_output: Runs no judge-round searches and makes one generate_playlist call whose description uses Nude by Radiohead as the start line, names no other tracks, uses 45 minutes, the 2-per-artist line and 'Call it Night drift.'
expectations: Makes no search calls for a judge round
Description contains 'Use Nude by Radiohead as the starting point.'
Description contains 'At most 2 songs per artist'
Description contains 'Call it Night drift.'
Description says about 45 minutes
